## SLA Window (SW)

Timezone + working windows (REUSES `@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/schedule`'s DayWindowField, so the shapes never drift) + holidays. Pure calendar data; all arithmetic is `@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/utils/sla`. Why a field when the Schedule CARD exists: an applied SLA must keep the window it was promised under, frozen at apply time — a later edit to the shared Schedule must not rewrite history.

### Non-goals

No math here (the service-desk SLA utilities own it). Empty windows mean always-on 24/7.
